text: dsh-file-context 是一个 DSH 工具插件，通过三个工具在当前工作区捕获本地文本文件片段、按快照 ID 读取已捕获内容，以及生成文件相对 Git 基准提交的差异快照。文件捕获支持指定行范围和预期版本校验；差异捕获支持 HEAD 或完整提交哈希。适合需要让 DSH 查看当前项目文件内容或变更差异的开发工作流。配置 root 可指定工作区，未配置时使用 agent 的工作目录。

dsh-file-context adds three DSH tools to capture local file excerpts, retrieve snapshots by ID, and capture a file diff against HEAD or a full commit hash. File capture supports line ranges and revision checks. Use an optional root or the agent working directory to inspect project files.
想让 DSH 读取项目里某个文件的指定几行。
怎样让 DSH 查看当前文件相对 HEAD 的 Git 改动？
I want DSH to capture a bounded excerpt from a local project file.
dsh-file-context 的功能「捕获文件片段」：调用 file_context_capture 并提供相对路径，可选指定起止行和预期版本；工具返回包含文本、行范围和完整文件版本摘要的不可变快照。
dsh-file-context 的功能「捕获 Git 文件差异」：调用 file_context_diff 并提供文件路径，可选以 HEAD 或完整提交哈希作为基准；工具返回该文件的差异文本快照。

@lightjunction/dsh-file-context README · dsh-file-context：DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 plugin. Node >=24; developed and tested locally with Node 26 / TypeScript 5.9.3. Release CI is configured for Node 24; that CI run is separate from local verification.

@lightjunction/dsh-file-context README · Install from a GitHub Release：After a release is published, install its built archive into your DSH profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile headless add https://github.com/LIghtJUNction/dsh-file-context/releases/download/v0.1.0/lightjunction-dsh-file-context-0.1.0.tgz
dsh headless --dump-config
```

@lightjunction/dsh-file-context README · Install from a GitHub Release：The release URL is the expected v0.1.0 asset location, not a claim that it has already been published. Use the archive and SHA256SUMS attached to the same GitHub Release. The package includes a DSH bundle patch and built JavaScript; no Pi dependency is needed. Restart DSH after installation. Substitute your existing profile for `headless` if needed.

@lightjunction/dsh-file-context README · Configuration：The default bundle config is `{}`: each tool uses the invoking agent's working directory. A host call without an agent requires an explicit `root`. To pin a host-local workspace, add an override in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-file-context
  config:
    root: /absolute/local/project
```

@lightjunction/dsh-file-context README · Configuration：The root must already exist. It is interpreted on the DSH host, using Node filesystem APIs. A remote DSH world or sandbox does not redirect these operations: only enable this plugin for a host-local project. This is not a remote-world adapter or a security sandbox.

@lightjunction/dsh-file-context README · Tools and examples：Ask DSH: “Capture lines 1–30 of src/index.ts, then compare the current diff against HEAD.” Results are tool content available to the model; file content remains untrusted data.

@lightjunction/dsh-file-context README · Limits and behavior：Reads reject traversal, absolute paths, `.git` segments, symlink files/ancestors, nonregular files, invalid UTF-8, binary data and files over 256 KiB. The canonical configured root itself may resolve a symlink. File revisions hash the full original UTF-8 text (including BOM); excerpts normalize CRLF line endings. Excerpts are limited to 500 lines and 50,000 UTF-8 bytes. The plugin holds at most 64 snapshots total in memory, with no disk spill or eviction; unload/reload clears them. Disposing an agent clears its snapshots; restarting DSH loses all snapshots. Calls that reach the cap fail explicitly.

@lightjunction/dsh-file-context README · Limits and behavior：Git diffs require the workspace to equal the Git repository root and the file to exist as bounded regular text. External diff drivers and textconv are disabled, pathspecs are literal, and subprocesses have cancellation, a five-second timeout and a bounded output buffer. Deleted files and untracked-file diffs are not supported. Diff snapshots hash diff text, not the worktree file.

@lightjunction/dsh-file-context README · Limits and behavior：There is no Pi file browser, menu, preview widget, external editor, blame/history viewer or automatic next-prompt injection. No file writes are provided. Concurrent capture calls preserve immutable snapshots. Dispose aborts and drains active work and unregisters tools.

@lightjunction/dsh-file-context README · Filesystem boundary and verification：Path checks reject ordinary symlink redirection; regular-file opens use no-follow flags and inode checks, bounded reads and cancellation. These checks are not a sandbox against a malicious process concurrently replacing ancestor directories; use a trusted local workspace. Linux/macOS-style filesystem semantics are the intended target; Windows behavior has not been verified.

```sh
npm run check
```

@lightjunction/dsh-file-context README · Filesystem boundary and verification：The suite uses real Cordis, DSH ToolRuntime, agent-loop and an offline scripted model; it verifies actual model tool dispatch and results in the following model request, plus limits, revision/path checks, cancellation and unregistration. It requires no live model credentials. `check` includes TypeScript checks for source/tests, behavior tests and a build. See [UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md) for pinned source and migration differences and [NOTICE](NOTICE) for upstream MIT attribution.
